title: {Syn} Simulated Annealing Borrows From Cooling Metal
content:
Simulated annealing is an optimization method that sometimes accepts worse moves early on, then becomes more conservative as the temperature schedule cools.

The metaphor comes from annealing in metallurgy, where controlled cooling helps material settle into lower-energy structures.

Why it matters: algorithms keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
